name: 60W Adjustable DC-DC Buck Converter Module (DFRobot DFR1025)
//: Catalog draft written by /spark:research on 2026-09-29 while researching the irrigation controller's 12 V -> 5 V buck; not chosen (see //why_not). Facts come ONLY from the DFRobot text at the cited URLs; photo and PDF URLs are listed in sources so `parts.py --fetch` keeps them, and were not read. verified:true = the vendor's own text at the URL; nothing here was measured or inferred.
//why_not: A 60 W / 18 A board shipped with its own heatsink, a switch-set output that can be set wrong, and a 9-15 V input window a sagging 12 V supply can fall out of — for a load of about 1 A.
//pins: Pinout on the wiki is an image only; not read. The product's shipping list adds '2Pin Terminal Block x2' and 'Aluminum Heat Sink x1', so input and output are screw terminals.

body_mm.note: wiki table 'Outline Dimension 52×37mm/2.05×1.46”'; thickness not stated

input_volts_min.why_it_matters: the floor is 9 V — a 12 V supply sagging under load has 3 V of margin, less than the DFR0831's 5 V.

input_volts_max.why_it_matters: a 12 V-only part: the wiki says 9V-15V.

output_volts_min.why_it_matters: wiki table 'Output Voltage 0.6V-5.1V'. The product page's Features line says '1.8~5.1V output voltage adjustable' — DFRobot's two texts disagree on the floor.

output_adjustable.why_it_matters: the wiki's docs blurb: 'detailed instructions on using DIP switches for precise output voltage configurations' — the output is set by DIP switches, so it can be set wrong.
output_adjustable.note: wiki reference blurb; the docs sub-page itself was not read

output_current_a.why_it_matters: wiki '18A(Active dissipation)' — with the heatsink, not bare.

protections.why_it_matters: product page: 'short-circuit protection, over-current protection, and overheating protection'

surface_temp_steady_c_max.why_it_matters: product page 'Safe Operating Range': <80 °C steady; 80-90 °C dissipation improvement recommended; >90 °C required, overheat protection may trigger.

ships_with.value: 2Pin Terminal Block x2, Aluminum Heat Sink x1
ships_with.why_it_matters: product page shipping list; the heatsink is part of the rating.

sourcing.note: structured data price 9.9; volume $9.70 (3+), $9.50 (5+), $9.20 (10+); schema.org InStock on the day
